description.text: The third expansion of the XY series, released on 14 June 2014, with Mega Lucario throwing an uppercut on the wrapper. It is built around Fighting-type Pokémon, led by Lucario-EX and M Lucario-EX, with Heracross-EX and M Heracross-EX, Seismitoad-EX, whose attack stops the opponent from playing Items on their next turn, and Dragonite-EX. It brought the fossil Pokémon Amaura and Tyrunt, put into play with an Item, and Strong Energy, a Special Energy for Fighting Pokémon. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 96, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Supporters, among them Korrina, and Ultra Rare M Heracross-EX and M Lucario-EX. In English most of its cards came out in Furious Fists in August 2014.
